Donor plugin lacks dedicated SubagentStart/SubagentStop/TaskCreated/TaskCompleted hook registrations.
Architecture specification expects handoff before native spawn and reconcile after spawn, leaving spawn outside stern.py handoff.

crosschecks.finding: Current docs expose call-scoped tool_use_id on tool hooks, unique agent_id on subagent lifecycle, separate task_id on task lifecycle, agent_id on tool hooks firing inside a subagent, and AgentOutput.agentId in the built-in Agent tool output contract. design_change.before: Package identity and native child execution identity were not closed; packet treated the tool_use_id -> agent_id join as wholly unproven.
design_change.after: Frankenstein 2.0 now has an explicit WorkExecutionBinding/v1 identity contract separating package_id, parent Agent tool_use_id, child agent_id, optional task_id, child tool_use_id and generation. The join is admitted only as documented ABI/source evidence until exact installed-runtime capture succeeds.
design_change.triggerword4_handoff: Port donor handoff/reconcile semantics, add native subagent lifecycle capture, bind package + generation + parent tool_use_id + child agent_id append-only, bind child effects to child agent_id + child tool_use_id, and require typed completion evidence. Do not use time/order/session-only joins.
